Native alias-keyed first-name capture (panels i1a, i1b, i1sa, i1sb)
Date: 2026-11-15 UTC. Salesforce CLI 2.156.8.
Org: one fresh 30-day Developer Edition scratch org (no features) on an authorized campaign Dev Hub, deleted after the run; deletion verified (active hub record 1 -> 0, the local target no longer resolves). No record, org or user id, username, alias or host is stored.
Preflight (before the org existed): every generated source was written as deployed at API 62.0 and 67.0; glade parse and glade check reported 0 diagnostics, the reserved-identifier lint was clean, and glade test and glade exec returned a framed observation for every case. The prediction was frozen before the native run.
APIs: 62.0 and 67.0. Classes redeployed for each API and ApexClass.ApiVersion read back. Routes: anonymous Apex and deployed @IsTest; two repeats. Eight observations per case; every case has eight identical observations.
Stages, rule state read back by SOQL after each deploy: first the standard rules as a fresh org has them (Standard_Contact_Duplicate_Rule active, no custom rule; i1sa, i1sb); then the standard duplicate rules deactivated and custom N1First (Contact, one FirstName item with the FirstName method, NullNotAllowed, Alert) active together with N1Last, N1Title and N1Phone (i1a, i1b).
Probe: one record per value is inserted (DMLOptions allowSave), then Datacloud.FindDuplicates runs on an unsaved copy of every value; only matches of the named rule are reported. Observation: <value count>:<pairs>; a pair is <candidate index><existing index><confidence>, indexes in 0-9a-z, a missing confidence is 100.
Companion fields: a custom-rule value carries a distinct last name ("first|last"); a standard-rule value carries one shared last name and email address ("first|last|email"), so only the first name differs.
Canary: a three-value panel (exact twin plus an unrelated value) ran before and after the cases, per stage, API, route and repeat: 32 observations, 0 failed.
Values: synthetic test-data shapes. i1a and i1sa hold one value list, i1b and i1sb another.
Leak scan: org.tsv and cases.json were grepped for 00D, 005 and 003 ids, Salesforce hosts, aliases and hub names: no hit.
